entries.subject: A false colour from three measured bands, as the HR 8799 planets have
entries.finding: A brown dwarf's visible spectrum is dominated by molecular and alkali absorption, so a blackbody colour at its temperature would not be its colour, and no calibrated visible spectrum of the resolved component is used here; it is the shared neutral gray.
entries.revisitWhen: Flux densities in three bands comparable with HR 8799's are published.
